official_replay_basis.cell: Pangaea Normal, 12-player official losses for qd1n:v89

episodes.observation: Odin opened alliance, alliance, alliance, 10, 10, 20, then 35-percent neutral expansion. Daveey made five 35-percent neutral expansions, built City at turn 900, then resumed 35-percent expansions and boats.
Daveey made five 35-percent neutral expansions, then built City at turn 800 before returning to expansion.
Richard made eleven consecutive 35-percent neutral expansions without a City. This falsifies a universal City-timing claim.

hypothesis.claim: In calm Pangaea openings, one early City after three large neutral conquests is a distinct daveey-style timing variable worth isolating; it is not a universal opener.
hypothesis.guard: Pangaea only; calm, non-collapsing state; under 12 percent land; under 14 active decisions; no City already built; at least three prior neutral attacks at 35 percent or more.
hypothesis.replacement: Choose the first legal City build before a voluntary coalition retry or another neutral expansion.
hypothesis.preserved: Actual reverse alliance handshakes retain priority; all v89 K1Z protection, attacks, boats, and normal neutral cadence remain unchanged.

pre_registered_gate.qualifier: marker reach, accepted decisions, zero unexplained holds or rejections, zero K1Z harm
pre_registered_gate.fast_screen: exact v89 candidate-parent Pangaea pair plus World identity pair
pre_registered_gate.advance: at least one non-negative paired score with clean reach and safety
pre_registered_gate.promotion: Only after matched advantage, hosted 4/4, regression 20/20, and live identity verification. No upload or league change at source-ready status.

qualifier_result: The valid four-player Pangaea fixture showed the parent already builds the same City after the third 35-percent expansion. EB3 emitted zero markers and recorded two candidate holds, so the arm is closed without mirrors.
